In the Court of the District & Sessions Judge,Araria
A.B.P. NO. 1952 of 2020
Arising out of Bhargama  P.S. case no. 01/2020     
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
Bholu Khan and an other
 
 Petitioner.
Versus
  State of Bihar                       
Opposite Party
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------     
                 Appearance:
     For the petitioners: Mr. M.Hussain, Advocate  
   For the prosecution:Mr. L.N.Yadav, P.P. 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This  anticipatory bail petition filed on behalf of accused petitioner
namely 1. Bholu  Khan and 2. Chotu @ Amjad Khan  who apprehends  arrest in
connection with Bhargama P.S. case no. 01/2020 u/s 147, 148, 149, 341, 323, 324,
379, 354, 307, 504, 506 I.P.C. pressed by  learned counsel.
  
Out of  these two petitioners, one of them namely Bholu Khan has
been arrested by the police during pendency of the instant A.B.P. hence the
anticipatory bail petition with respect to the petitioner Bholu Khan is dismissed as
withdrawn being infructuous and his name has been deleted from the instant
A.B.P. 
Heard both the sides in physical mode of court proceeding.  
The learned counsel for the accused petitioner submits  that the
petitioner is innocent who has committed no offence and has been falsely
implicated in this case due previous enmity and land dispute and all the offences
are bailable except 379,354 and 307 I.P.C. but the allegation for the offences
punishable u/s 354 and 379 I.P.C. are general and super addition and offence
punishable u/s 307 I.P.C. is not attracted against the petitioner as there is  no
repetition of blow by the petitioner. There is prior enemical terms running
between the parties and  petitioner side has also lodged Bhargama P.S. case no.
4/2020 against the informant side, hence the petitioner deserves to be released on
anticipatory bail. 
The learned P.P. opposed the anticipatory  bail. 
Heard the submissions of both the sides and perused the L.C.R. As
per allegation of F.I.R. being written report of informant Nasrin Khanam
petitioner Chotu @ Amjad Khan carry specific allegation for inflicting fatal
assault in fatal manner  by stroke of Farsa causing injury on the head of injured
Rarwar Khan with intent to kill life. So, considering the nature of allegation and
the informant in her restatement in para 6 and witnesses in para 7,8,17 of the case
diary have supported the allegation as alleged against the petitioner and
investigation is still going on, therefore, I find it is not a fit case to grant
anticipatory bail. Accordingly, anticipatory bail prayer of the petitioner Chotu @
Amjad Khan stands rejected. 
(Dictated)
    sd/-
(P.K.Dixit) 
         Session Judge
13.01.2021
